title: Heart of the Prism
author: Inbar Rose
architectNote: The climax macro-labyrinth. Traverse the four elemental quadrant sanctums and claim the Crown of the Prism at the central altar.

help.title: Level 40: Heart of the Prism
help.message: Four elemental seals guard the heart of the prism. Explore all four quadrants, cross elevated viaducts, and breach the central sanctuary.
